string.body: Can be used on packable eternal weapons up to level 60 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click (right-click) on this scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_XP_BOOST_50_DESC
string.body: You receive 50%% additional XP while hunting, gathering and crafting for as long as Snorinerk's Amulet is active.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_GATHER_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: Essence and Aether Extraction as well as the "Gathering" skill is increased by 200%%.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_AP_BOOST_30_DESC
string.body: As long as the effect holds, you receive 30%% additional Abyss points. This, however, does not apply for achievements on the Dredgion and in the Crucible Challenge Training Camp.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_CRAFT_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: You receive 200%% additional Skill Points for the duration of the effect.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes. The recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_DROP_BOOST_20_DESC
string.body: The chance of capturing items from creatures when hunting is increased by 20%% while this effect lasts.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SLOW_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's attack speed by 50%% for 10 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SNARE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's movement speed by 50%% for 10 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_STUN_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that stuns a target for 1 second with 7%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_PARALYZE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that paralyses a target for 4 seconds with 3%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_WRAP_INTERACTIVE_NORMAL_01_DESC
string.body: The Chaos Rift Loot.\nContains Manastones and various rewards.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_INTERACTIVE_SUPER_01_DESC
string.body: The Chaos Rift Victory Bounty.\nContains Ceranium Medals and various rewards.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_OPTION_L_60_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Alabaster Order's Regenerating Manastones.\nIt contains various regenerating Manastones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_UE_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Alabaster Order's Old Manastones.\nIt contains various old Manastones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MEDAL_01_DESC
string.body: A chest of Radiant Ops medals.\nIt contains Platinum Medals, Ceranium Medals and other medals. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_PROC_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Fortuneer's Illusion Godstones.\nIt contains various Illusion Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_ENCHANT_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Fortuneer's Special Enchantment Stones.\nIt contains various Enchantment Stones. With a little luck, you will also receive an All-Powerful Enchantment Stone.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_MATTER_OPTION_L_60_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Field Wardens' Regenerating Manastones.\nIt contains various regenerating Manastones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_UE_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Field Wardens Old Manastones.\nIt contains various old Manastones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_MEDAL_01_DESC
string.body: A chest of Blood Crusade medals.\nIt contains Platinum Medals, Ceranium Medals and other medals. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_MATTER_PROC_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Illusion Godstones from Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nIt contains various Illusion Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_MATTER_ENCHANT_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Special Enchantment Stones from Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nIt contains various Enchantment Stones. With a little luck, you will also receive an All-Powerful Enchantment Stone.\nDouble-click to open.
